name: monsterenergy.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome. Partial analysis: 76 of 76 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.monsterenergy.com scores 71 out of 100 (C). 6 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: plain http serves the site without redirecting.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /nl-be/, for example .logo and .slider-items > .list-inline-item:nth-child(1) > a[target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /nl-be/, for example #countryPop. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 36 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /nl-be/, for example .cc-link[aria-label="customize cookie usage"][href="javascript:void(0);"]:nth-child(3) and .cc-dismiss. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /nl-be/, for example a[aria-label="3 / 4"] > .text-wrapper > h4 and a[aria-label="3 / 4"] > .text-wrapper > .product-name. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page

The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 1.0 s

Language alternates point at each other
